english.note: Use this for getting through prolonged hardship or for something lasting under difficult conditions, rather than for neutral continuation.

exampleSentences.english: Once we endure this most difficult period, things will be fine.
exampleSentences.traditional: 捱過呢段最辛苦嘅日子就好喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngaai4 gwo3 ni1 dyun6 zeoi3 san1 fu2 ge3 jat6 zi2 zau6 hou2 laa3

english.note: Use this colloquially when the emphasis is on enduring hardship, pain, or difficulty.

exampleSentences.english: I had to undergo months of pain from my illness.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ngaai4 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 beng6 tung3
